    About Project:

    Comprised of the Company’s international business units and various direct-to-consumer streaming services, Media & Entertainment Distribution department aligns technology, media distribution and advertising sales into a single business segment to create and deliver personalized entertainment experiences to consumers around the world.

    About Company:

    Leading diversified international family entertainment and media enterprise with the following business segments: media networks, parks and resorts, studio entertainment, consumer products and interactive media. 


    Requirements:

    • Readiness to work till 12 AM Kyiv time, 11 PM Poland time

    Position Overview

    As a Senior Automation QA Engineer, you will join our QA team to contribute to the development of a biometric-based identity verification solution. This product helps organizations securely verify user identities through modern authentication and authorization technologies, ensuring seamless and secure access to digital services.
     

    In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining robust automated testing frameworks for web applications, ensuring product quality, reliability, and scalability. You will work closely with developers, product stakeholders, and other QA engineers to improve testing processes, identify risks early, and drive continuous quality improvements throughout the software development lifecycle.
     

    We are looking for a proactive and self-driven professional who can work independently, investigate issues, challenge existing approaches, and propose meaningful software improvements. Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders are essential for success in this role.
     

    Project Description

    We are developing an advanced biometric identity verification platform that enables secure authentication and user verification across digital channels. The solution combines modern web technologies, cloud infrastructure, and authentication protocols to deliver highly secure and scalable identity management services.
     

    The platform supports enterprise-grade authentication workflows and integrates with various third-party identity providers and authorization systems. The product operates in a cloud-native environment and follows a microservices architecture, ensuring high availability, performance, and scalability.
     

    Technology Stack

    • Architecture: Microservices
    • Programming Language: JavaScript / TypeScript
    • Test Automation: Playwright
    • Performance Testing: JMeter
    • Mobile Automation: Appium, WebdriverIO (WDIO)
    • Database: MongoDB
    • API Testing: Postman, Playwright
    • Version Control: Git
    • CI/CD: Jenkins, Github
    • Cloud Platforms: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS
       

    Your Background 

    • 5+ years of commercial experience in web automation testing using JavaScript or TypeScript
    • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Playwright
    • Strong understanding of QA methodologies, testing processes, and software development lifecycle
    • Experience with REST API testing using Postman
    • Solid understanding of client-server architecture
    • Experience with Git version control systems
    • Experience configuring and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins)
    • Ability to work independently and proactively in a fast-paced environment
    • Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail
    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
    • English level: Intermediate+ (B2) or higher
       

    Skills That Will Be a Plus

    • Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter
    • Experience with authentication and authorization protocols (SAML, OpenID Connect)
    • Experience working with Google Cloud Platform
    • Experience with mobile test automation using Appium
    • Previous experience with authentication or identity verification solutions
       

    Responsibilities

    • Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test frameworks for web applications
    • Create and maintain automated test scripts using JavaScript/TypeScript, Playwright, and Appium
    • Analyze product requirements and manual test cases and transform them into comprehensive automated test scenarios
    • Perform functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing
    • Execute API testing and validate backend integrations
    • Manage and maintain QA environments and automated testing infrastructure
    • Ensure proper test coverage and continuous quality validation throughout the development lifecycle
    • Collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to identify and resolve quality issues
    • Contribute to process improvements and promote QA best practices across the team
    • Continuously learn new technologies and testing approaches to improve product quality and team efficiency
       

    We Offer

    • 20 billable days off during the first year of cooperation, 25 billable days off from the second year onward
    • Fair and competitive compensation
    • Flexible working schedule
    • Fully remote work environment
    • Friendly and supportive team culture
    • Clear and well-established business processes
    • Regular company updates and Q&A sessions with leadership
    • Opportunities for professional growth and continuous learning
    • Challenging and innovative projects utilizing modern technologies

    About the Project

    The project is a product in the regulated medical software and medical devices domain, where quality, reliability and compliance are critical. We are looking for a QA Engineer who combines manual and automated testing and uses Python on a daily basis, to help ensure the product meets its quality and compliance goals throughout the development life cycle. The role also has some overlap with the PST time zone. .

     

    Responsibilities

    • Design, write and execute functional, regression and integration test cases across the product.
    • Build and maintain automated test scripts and supporting tooling in Python on a day-to-day basis.
    • Work within a regulated software development life cycle and keep test documentation, traceability and evidence in good order.
    • Contribute to verification and validation activities and support release readiness.
    • Report, track and verify defects with clear reproduction steps and severity assessment.
    • Take part in performance and stress testing activities where they overlap with the role.
    • Collaborate with developers, product and the client's stakeholders throughout the delivery cycle.

    Requirements

    • Experience: 2+ years of overall QA experience.
    • Manual and automation: hands-on experience in both manual testing and test automation.
    • Python scripting: hands-on Python used day to day for test automation and tooling.
    • Software life cycle: a solid understanding of the software development life cycle and structured QA processes.
    • Standards and regulations: some knowledge of relevant standards, regulations and compliance practices, and a readiness to work within them.
    • English: spoken and written English at a confident Intermediate level or above.
    • Mindset: a careful, detail-oriented and evidence-driven approach suited to a regulated environment.

    Nice to Have

    • Similar project experience: 1+ year on a similar (medical or regulated) project is a plus but not required.
    • Medical devices experience: previous experience testing medical devices or medical software is ideal but not a must-have.
    • Performance and stress testing: experience with load and stress testing and tools such as k6, JMeter or Locust.
    • Automation tooling: familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git and test reporting.
